key.name: telegram-token
key.description: The token BotFather gave for the bot that tasks are sent to. Empty when Telegram is not set up.

key.name: telegram-bot-name
key.description: The username of the bot, without the @, for linking to its chat.

key.name: telegram-chat-id
key.description: The one chat whose messages are added to the list. Zero until someone first writes to the bot.

key.name: telegram-list-message-id
key.description: The message in the chat that shows the list. Zero until it has been sent.

key.name: telegram-offset
key.description: The first update not yet read, so a restart does not add the same tasks twice.
